invalidation_policy.source_test_dependency_build_environment: Rerun all affected automated/archive/calibration/lifecycle/manual/visual/benchmark checks or record explicit reviewed equivalence against the exact final composition. No transfer based only on a new build passing.
invalidation_policy.documentation_only_change: May retain evidence only if implementation/test/config/dependency/fixture hashes relevant to the claim are unchanged; record scoped equivalence rather than relying on branch name.
invalidation_policy.private_fixture_change_or_unavailability: Invalidate matching results; no silent path/fixture substitution. Repository controls remain usable but cannot impersonate the external workload.
invalidation_policy.new_generated_fixture: Materialize with recorded generator/source recipe and hash outputs before accepting its first result. Planned recipes are not executed fixtures.
invalidation_policy.renderer_profile_or_instrumentation_chan: Rerun affected GUI/performance/resource results; offscreen, native X11 and instrumented/normal builds are distinct evidence populations.
invalidation_policy.final_confirmation_task: T010.1 must compare the final candidate/PR composition and invalidate affected correctness/manual and benchmark results before T010 sign-off.

platform_scope.initial_selected: Linux x86_64; Qt offscreen for bounded unit tests, native X11 for explicit desktop/rendered checks with captured renderer receipt
platform_scope.final_gate: T010 must declare and obtain required supported-platform CI/manual coverage for actual production PR revisions; local candidate does not waive those gates.

workflow.before_source_tasks: Verify manifest/submodules/config/fixture identities; use named source branches descended from or explicitly reconciled to this intake source; refresh receipts as fixes change implementation. Keep unrelated console docs untouched.
workflow.before_acceptance: Use the verified Pixi --locked option: configure when required, then pixi run --locked build -j 2 on the actual chosen composition. Abort on lock drift; record resulting source/dependency/environment identities, new binary and resolved-runtime provenance before task-specific acceptance. Never silently solve/update the lock.
workflow.before_measurements: Resolve D001/T001 endpoints, per-optimization inventory, warm/cold/sample/statistics/pass rules. T019 does not choose or approve speedup thresholds.
workflow.before_closure: T010.1 final revision/evidence reconciliation and T011 promotion/ownership/closure; D002 remains separate.
